claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the organizer's high-quality, thick, sturdy acrylic construction.
Many customers say it holds a lot and keeps makeup and brushes organized and visible.
Several reviewers appreciate its clear, stylish look that fits well on a vanity or counter.
Some reviewers note the compartments are oddly sized or narrow and don't fit many items.
A few customers mention it is large or pricey, recommending measuring first.
